description: Coach the business's agent. With call_id: what the agent did well and what to change on that call, each point with the caller's or agent's exact words, the second it happened, and a one-line rule that would fix it (teach it with teach_coaching_rule). Without call_id: the agent's recurring habits across recent calls (how often, example calls, and whether a rule taught for it has worked). Read-only.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the key can reach more than one business.

call_id.description: Coach one call. Omit for habits across calls.
